name: China
description: China from the Shang kings to the People's Republic: dynasties, inventions, revolutions and the rise of a modern power.

checkpoints.name: Shang and Zhou
checkpoints.note: The Shang write on oracle bones and cast bronze. The Zhou rule for centuries, and in their warring last years Confucius and Laozi teach.

checkpoints.name: Qin and Han
checkpoints.note: Qin Shi Huang unites China and is buried with the Terracotta Army. The Han open the Silk Road, invent paper and give the Chinese people their name.

checkpoints.name: Three Kingdoms to Tang
checkpoints.note: China splits and is reunited by the Sui, who dig the Grand Canal. The Tang rule a golden age of poetry, trade and Buddhism.

checkpoints.name: Song and Yuan
checkpoints.note: The Song invent printing with movable type, gunpowder weapons and paper money. Kublai Khan's Mongols conquer China and found the Yuan.

checkpoints.name: Ming
checkpoints.note: The Ming build the Forbidden City and the Great Wall as it stands today, and Zheng He's fleets sail as far as Africa.

checkpoints.name: Qing
checkpoints.note: The Manchu Qing rule the largest China ever. The Opium Wars and the Taiping Rebellion weaken them, and the last emperor falls in 1911.

checkpoints.name: Republic and war
checkpoints.note: The republic is torn by warlords, invasion by Japan and civil war between the Nationalists and the Communists.

checkpoints.name: The People's Republic
checkpoints.note: Mao proclaims the People's Republic in 1949. Famine and the Cultural Revolution follow, then Deng's reforms make China the world's workshop and a superpower.
